feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
entry.summary: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

entry.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

entry.title: Schools struggle to measure how much AI experiments are helping
entry.summary: Schools are experimenting with AI, and a lot of them are encountering the same problem: It's hard to measure whether the technology is good or bad for students.

entry.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
entry.summary: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.

entry.title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
entry.summary: More than $15 billion has been raised in this year's midterm elections. And, France's president is condemning the violent protests erupting across the country.

entry.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
entry.summary: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.

entry.title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
entry.summary: Hint: It's not only because California counts slowly.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes as relations between U.S. and Ukraine deteriorate, the midterms are on track to be the most expensive on record, French president denounces violent protests.

entry.title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
entry.summary: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

entry.title: Solar power is changing agriculture in Pakistan, but some fear it could cause issues
entry.summary: Solar power is transforming agriculture in Pakistan. But in a country already facing water scarcity and extreme weather, some fear their widespread use could cause problems.
